items.name: eva-badge
items.title: Eva Badge
items.description: Framed interface labels with one or two text levels and an optional separator.
items.docs: The size prop controls the whole frame. Use width and height for exact dimensions; both text zones fit themselves to the available area. Add secondary for a second level, separator for the internal rule, emphasis="secondary" when the lower level should dominate, and lang="ja" for Japanese interface text.

items.name: eva-text
items.title: Eva Text
items.description: Display typography with Evangelion-inspired font roles, tracking, and horizontal scaling.
items.docs: Horizontal scaling changes the rendered shape without changing layout width. Use it for headings and labels, not body-copy wrapping.
